impact: N-008 VAL-UI-014 requires a startup probe that shows a blocking install-hint modal when `xdg-desktop-portal` (or `pipewire`) is absent from the system. No such probe exists anywhere in electron/main.ts, electron/recorder.ts, or the renderer. The app will silently fail at capture time rather than surfacing a clear install hint at boot. Prevents T-010d acceptance and T-010e gate.
resolution: Implemented in commit 8331348. checkDependencies() in engine-supervisor.ts checks fs.existsSync sentinels for /usr/share/dbus-1/services/org.freedesktop.portal.Desktop.service (xdg-desktop-portal) and /usr/bin/pipewire before helper launch on Linux. Missing sentinel throws missing-dependency with detail field; main.ts routes it through existing cove/engine/blocked IPC; Diagnostics.tsx renders dep-specific install-hint blocking modal. Terminal in both initial boot and restart paths. Release policy: supported targets are standard package-manager installs on Debian/Ubuntu/Arch/Fedora FHS-compatible distros. Non-standard installs out of scope for v2.0.0.
title: VAL-UI-014: dependency probe (pipewire/xdg-desktop-portal) not implemented
